# Jernbane Cafeen

Jernbane Cafeen is a cafe and restaurant in the historic station building at Lille Torv 3, 7430 Ikast, Denmark.

## Business

Jernbane Cafeen is run by Niels and Rapheephon Rasmussen. The cafe opened in its current form in 2023.

## Food

The kitchen serves classic Danish cafe food and homemade Thai food. The menu changes over time. The cafe also offers today's dish, takeaway, catering and private dining.

## Location

Address: Lille Torv 3, 7430 Ikast, Denmark.

## Opening hours

- Monday: Closed
- Tuesday: Closed
- Wednesday: 16:00 to 20:00
- Thursday: 12:00 to 20:00
- Friday: 12:00 to 20:00
- Saturday: 12:00 to 20:00
- Sunday: 12:00 to 19:00

Opening hours can change. Confirm by phone before travelling for a special occasion.

## Contact

Phone: +45 30 80 72 41
Email: info@jbcafeen.dk

The cafe states that it normally replies to enquiries within 48 hours.

## Menu

- Main page: https://jbcafeen.dk/
- Menu: https://jbcafeen.dk/menu.html
- Today's dish: https://jbcafeen.dk/dagens-ret.html

## Catering and private dining

Catering is available for smaller gatherings and takeaway. Private dining with Niels can be requested for a meal in the customer's own home. More information about the separate private-dining service is available at https://www.lejenkok.dk.
